prompt: Index the codebase in the current directory
expectations: Dispatches codebase-mapper first (Wave 1) before any other sub-agent
Writes or updates .indexing-kb/_meta/manifest.json after each wave
Asks user before overwriting an existing .indexing-kb/ with status: complete
Reports PASS/PASS_WITH_GAPS/FAIL verdict from indexing-auditor to user

prompt: Re-index the codebase — the source has changed since last time
expectations: Detects existing .indexing-kb/ and asks user: skip / re-run / revise
Does not auto-overwrite without user confirmation
After user confirms re-run, dispatches full Wave 1–4a pipeline
